method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (9 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 9 Nov 2026: OECD GloBE Model Rules / Pillar Two page re-fetched; no new model rules, AG, GIR, Central Record or Full Legislative Review since catalogued items (plenary 30 Oct; GIR XML Schema v2.0 ~20 Oct; Romania STTR 2 Oct). 4 Nov Tax Certainty Day OECD announcement is 2025 MAP/APA statistics (BEPS Action 14), not Pillar Two. Speech coverage (Bloomberg/Meijburg) on a taxpayer-initiated GloBE coordination mechanism remains secondary remarks already foreshadowed in the 30 Oct plenary statement — no standalone OECD GloBE document published.
coverage.HK: Checked 9 Nov 2026: IRD What's New and GMT/HKMTT page fetched. Only in-window Pillar Two item remains 26 Oct Portal BIR82 filing / e-assessments. 2–4 Nov What's New / press covers LegCo CARF & Amended CRS Bill — not Pillar Two. No new HKMTT/IIR guidance or portal change.
coverage.SG: Checked 9 Nov 2026: IRAS GloBE/DTT page and PwC Singapore Tax News (through 30 Oct; no newer SG Pillar Two entries) re-fetched. Catalogued items unchanged: Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 (Act 23) published Acts Supplement 4 Nov; Third Edition e-Tax Guide (30 Oct); QTI/SBTI list (13 Oct). MMT Regulations for safe harbours still pending. No new IRAS guidance or SSO MMT subsidiary legislation since 6 Nov.
coverage.JP: Checked 9 Nov 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched (through 2 Nov). In-window catalogued item unchanged (GIR AEOI partners 21 Oct). The 9 Oct 趣旨説明 remains catalogued but now falls just before the rolling 30-day window starting 10 Oct. 2 Nov tobacco hand-held stock tax; 30 Oct CbCR EOI partner-list update and 法人税基本通達 opinion solicitation confirmed non-Pillar Two (CbCR ≠ GIR). No new JP IIR/QDMTT/GIR administrative guidance.
